brief:
Israeli military and security officials warned Wednesday that the West Bank resembles a "powder keg" capable of detonating at any moment, citing escalating settler violence against Palestinians, according to Shehab Wire. The assessment reflects deepening concern among Israel's defense establishment over the trajectory of tensions in the territory.

The officials attributed the volatile situation partly to a breakdown in accountability mechanisms. Military officers have resisted taking action against settlers accused of attacking Palestinians, citing concerns that prosecution could damage their own military careers and advancement. This reluctance to enforce consequences has allowed the cycle of violence to intensify unchecked, security sources said.
